name: Event stream
tagline: Tail your WhatsApp number from Node.js: a live event log is the hero, and each event opens into its handler, payload and plugin route.
audience: Node.js developers who want WhatsApp in their app (indie, agency, in-house, AI-agent builders)
flow: Copy the run command from the board's header bar, then Quick start; open an event to see the handler and route it
